ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 85% high-intensity (off-white) pixels forming the central surface and 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized at the margins and peduncle junction.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white ventral surface bounded by a continuous black trailing edge. Distinct vertical linear dark streaks are localized along the superior edge of both lobes. A dark, diffuse pixel cluster is visible at the central base near the peduncle attachment.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; central vertex is clearly defined with symmetric divergent lines forming the medial lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) distributed continuously along the trailing edge, with increased amplitude visible on the right lobe's distal margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch and extending toward the lateral tips, exhibiting a smooth geometric arc interrupted by serration peaks.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel vertical dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) extending from the trailing edge toward the interior fluke surface on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks/scars along the superior margins of both fluke lobes, creating a feathered or comb-like pigmentation pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'brush-stroke' appearance of black pigment bleeding into the white field from the trailing edge serrations.
